cardOverview.overviewText: A popular Amazon Pay card offering cashback on Amazon purchases, utilities, and partner spends, with instant redemption into Amazon Pay balance.

items.child: 100% back up to Rs 100 on Amazon shopping on Non EMI order on minimum transaction of INR 1 (Prime Members).|100% back up to Rs 100 on Amazon shopping on Non EMI order on minimum transaction of INR 1 (Non-Prime).

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary EazyDiner Prime membership for 1 month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Download the EazyDiner Application.|Sign up for new customers or login for existing customer.|Select 12-Month EazyDiner Prime Membership plan and click on Pay Now.|Apply the unique coupon code received from ICICI Bank via SMS/E-mail.|Complete purchase and activate your Annual Prime membership.
benefitRows.exclusion:
1. The membership is applicable for Primary Card Members only.
2. These vouchers are valid within the validity period mentioned in the voucher
code sms/e-mail received from ICICI Bank.
